subject: CP FY 23
topic: FW: [EXTERNAL] Please support Safe Side Streets Part 2 CP - thanks!
comment: Dear Councilperson Petro-Eschler, I hope you are well today. I am a resident of District 7 and am asking for your support on the GP Safe Club Streets Part 2. We had funding but plot to route the baseline issues in our area, we have looked at what our council can do. Thank you for taking time with your staff to read this. We have family members who have visited in this area since we moved here from 2004-2106 and switched in 2105, and we are committed to partnering to reduce speeds and counts of traffic as the main corridors of Sugar House grow. Our area is particularly because we are on a road and where too traffic go. Well! We are a model for the rest of the city and we are in to be a laboratory for change! We know the results of our study, and we are the second major area of investment of Millcreek City dollars. We need to prioritize the way our kids and children get around the city, and we are excited and they and our worries are daily. We are interested in affordable, simple solutions, targeted to the places it will make the best impact and not hurt our wonderful community. We can work together to find these solutions. We need your help and are ready to build. Please lend us in part or in whole with our GP. Thank you for your attention and time. Sarah Woolley
